title: These ‘KPop Demon Hunters’ Blind Bag Collectible Figurines Double as Backpack Charms
summary: Each mystery pack contains one of nine characters from the hit animated film.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

KPop Demon Hunters fans can add a collectible figurine to their everyday gear with this officially licensed backpack charm release. The collectibles come in a mysterious blind bag, which each contain one of nine sculpted character figures with a distinct pose and expression.

Each statuette includes a metal clip, so it can be attached to a backpack for school, a lunch bag, zipper pull, a set of keys or a purse. The clip-on feature makes it an easy way to personalize school gear, especially alongside the franchise’s growing lineup of back-to-school merch, including backpacks , kids Vans sneakers and water bottles . Of course it’s great for all ages, with adult Demon Hunters fans clipping these colorful charms onto their bags and totes.

Each figure is fully sculpted in 3D and measures just under three inches in size.

The blind bag format means the character you get is completely random, with nine designs available to collect, including HUNTR/X’s Rumi, Mira and Zoey, and Saja Boys Jinu, Abby, Mystery, Romance and Baby. The clumsy but beloved Blue Tiger Derpy is also one of the characters thrown into the mix.

Each character has their own distinct features, outfits and hairstyles, and Rumi, Mira and Zoey are even carrying their iconic swords . Designed for ages four and up, the blind bag also comes with stickers and an anime-style door hanger.

The product is part of the official KPop Demon Hunters merchandise line that’s come out of the widely successful film, with new releases including everything from Mattel dolls and phone huggers to books and Little People Collector Sets .

The success of KPop Demon Hunters has extended well beyond merchandise. Netflix says the film has surpassed 600 million views, making it the streamer’s most popular original title, while “Golden” won Best Original Song at the 2026 Oscars. That momentum led Netflix and AEG Presents to announce the  K-pop Demon Hunters world concert tour for 2027. Cities, dates and ticket on-sale details have yet to be announced.
